in_sanskrit.name: सत्यास्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: सत्यम् असत्यम् परब्रह्मणस्य अस्य अस्ति तत् (Satyam asti param Brahmaasya asti tat) - This is the truth or reality of the Supreme Self.

in_marathi.name: Satyaasya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Satyaasya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Satyaasya is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Satya', which means 'truth' or 'reality'. In Hindu mythology, Satyaasya is a name given to several gods and goddesses representing truth and honesty.
